facts.fact: Miri 在海洋调查中心的欢送酒会上被一名海藻专家搭话，整晚困在冗长闲聊里
facts.anchor: I spent much of the night caught up in interminable conversation with a man who specialised in seaweed

facts.fact: 当晚早些时候 Miri 与 Leah 吵过一架，已记不清究竟为什么
facts.anchor: Earlier in the evening we had fought, I forget about what exactly.

facts.fact: 散场敬酒时 Miri 把头埋进 Leah 颈侧，为那场争吵道歉
facts.anchor: turned my head into her neck and whispered that I was sorry about the fight

facts.fact: Miri 在读一本慈善商店淘来的人体解剖学教科书，专看前主人的划线
facts.anchor: The book I am reading is a textbook on human anatomy

facts.fact: Leah 在浴室里待了两个多小时，开着水龙头和声音机
facts.anchor: Leah has been in the bathroom for upwards of two hours

facts.fact: Miri 某夜赌气搬进客房，本打算只住一晚却再没搬回
facts.anchor: I had intended to stay in the spare room only one night and yet somehow never moved back

facts.fact: Leah 出浴后 Miri 去擦浴缸上那层粉色黏垢
facts.anchor: scrub at the bath with the sponge I keep beneath the sink

facts.fact: 母亲病重独居海边，几乎拒绝 Miri 的一切帮助，最终被送进临终关怀院
facts.anchor: She refused almost every aspect of my help
